params.1273: Locate and enter the Air Altar.
params.1274: The Air Altar is outside Burthorpe, a long way to the east.
params.1275: To get there quickly, activate the wicked hood by left-clicking it.
params.1276: Select the Air icon (the white one) and then click on 'teleport'.
params.1277: To enter the Air Altar itself, click on the Mysterious Ruins.
